_comment_single_site: Used only when slnLaunchFile below is not set.
_comment_drive_mappings: Optional. Map drive letter(s) before each Build/Run SSH command, e.g. when a postbuild event fails against a UNC path directly.
_comment_skip_build_events: Optional. Defaults to true, blanking out each project's PreBuildEvent/PostBuildEvent so they don't run against the remote machine. Set to false to let them run normally.
_comment_multi_site: Set these to launch multiple projects together, driven by a Visual Studio .slnLaunch / .slnLaunch.user file.
